description.en: A glass W-emblem disc and an eight-disc optical ring animate inside contrasting cards, each with an independent details overlay.
description.zh: 玻璃 W 徽标圆片与八片圆盘环分别在黑白卡片中转动，两张卡片各有独立详情层。

keywords: 3D 光学 玻璃 圆片 圆盘 W 徽标 旋转 光纤 双卡 详情 raymarch SDF glass coin optical fibers discs WebGL praveenisomer

useCases: 带SDF玻璃圆片与光学圆盘动画的双介绍卡
Two informational cards with raymarched glass and optical-disc scenes
discovery.caveat: 详情为本地信息层，无AI或网络服务。支持WebGL2/WebGL1；无WebGL时静态2D示意。源码许可未核实，字体保留OFL。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML adapted to an instance-scoped DOM/WebGL2/WebGL1 core with six native framework entries. Canvas2D provides a static fallback; Learn More opens local informational details. Font subsets and full OFL notices are bundled.
source.license: No separate source license was supplied or verified. Plus Jakarta Sans and Space Mono are bundled with their SIL Open Font License notices.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Click Learn More for the card details, then use Close or Escape to return.
instructions.zh: 点击 Learn More 查看卡片详情，用 Close 或 Esc 返回。
